name: m4-branch-int148-scala
description: Per first-parent commit of the rebuilt integration branch (2.13.x `278cab1040` .. `f0b6e17bd9`): which merged PR moves a full compile of the scala corpus. Extended from `00e3bbafb8` with retronym/scala#199, #207, #205, #204 (latest version), a commit defaulting `-Yname-table` to `shared`, and #208 and #209. Commits before that default use `chars`, so the shared table shows as its own step. Follows `m4-main-int148-jdk26-scala` (main → int148: −12.3% instructions/op, −13.5% cycles/op on the M4).

On the M4, 1 round, xctrace ipc; release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); patched JDK 26 (`jdk26-integration-branch-e9e67e`), corpus compiled against JDK 25's API (`jdkHome=25.0.4-tem`); 8G heap, 6 × 20 s warmup, 6 × 20 s measured. The test-only and PERF-INTEGRATION.md commits change no compiler code, so they are A/A controls for their neighbours.
